The role is responsible for ensuring that all technical activities are delivered to the required quality, safety, performance, cost, and regulatory standards. The Technical Lead will work closely with management, clients, vendors, contractors, and internal teams to translate business and project requirements into practical technical solutions. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with project leadership, problem-solving, team management, stakeholder engagement, and commercial awareness. Key Responsibilities A. Technical Leadership & Strategy Provide technical leadership across Noble Eagle’s projects and operational activities. Translate business and client requirements into clear technical solutions and execution plans. Establish and maintain technical standards, specifications, procedures, and best practices. Review technical requirements and advise management on appropriate solutions, technologies, materials, systems, and methodologies. Identify opportunities to improve technical processes, efficiency, reliability, and quality. Stay abreast of relevant technologies, industry developments, regulations, and technical standards. Provide expert technical input into business proposals, tenders, bids, and new projects. B. Project Technical Delivery Lead the technical aspects of projects from planning through execution, commissioning, and close-out. Review project scope, drawings, specifications, designs, technical documents, and deliverables. Ensure technical deliverables are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with approved requirements. Coordinate technical activities across engineering, operations, procurement, contractors, and other project teams. Identify technical risks, dependencies, constraints, and potential project issues early. Provide technical solutions to challenges arising during project execution. Participate in project planning, progress meetings, technical reviews, and client meetings. Ensure proper documentation and handover of completed technical works. C. Design, Engineering & Technical Review Review and validate engineering designs, calculations, drawings, specifications, and technical submissions, as applicable to the business. Ensure designs and technical solutions are practical, cost-effective, safe, and fit for purpose. Review technical documentation prepared by internal teams, consultants, vendors, and contractors. Coordinate design reviews and resolve technical clashes or inconsistencies. Ensure technical changes are properly evaluated, documented, approved, and implemented. Maintain technical integrity throughout the project lifecycle. D. Technical Team Leadership Lead, coordinate, and provide technical direction to engineers, technicians, specialists, and other technical personnel. Allocate technical resources according to project priorities and business requirements. Set clear technical expectations and monitor team performance. Coach and mentor team members to strengthen technical capability. Identify training and development needs within the technical team. Promote knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and technical excellence. Build a culture of accountability, innovation, safety, and quality. E. Quality Assurance & Technical Compliance Ensure technical activities comply with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, specifications, and company policies. Establish appropriate quality control and inspection processes. Review quality documentation, inspection reports, test results, and technical certificates where applicable. Identify technical defects, non-conformities, and recurring quality issues and ensure corrective actions are implemented. Participate in technical audits, inspections, and compliance reviews. Ensure technical records and documentation are complete, accurate, and properly maintained. F. Troubleshooting & Technical Problem-Solving Serve as the primary escalation point for complex technical issues. Investigate technical failures, defects, performance issues, and operational challenges. Conduct root-cause analysis and develop sustainable corrective and preventive actions. Provide timely technical recommendations to management and project teams. Support emergency technical interventions where required. Ensure lessons learned from technical incidents are documented and incorporated into future projects. G. Vendor, Contractor & Consultant Management Provide technical input into the selection and evaluation of contractors, consultants, suppliers, and technical vendors. Review vendor technical proposals, specifications, drawings, and submissions. Monitor contractor and vendor technical performance. Ensure third-party technical work meets approved standards and specifications. Participate in technical negotiations and clarification meetings. Review and approve technical deliverables within delegated authority. Escalate contractor or vendor performance issues where technical requirements are not being met. H. Procurement & Technical Commercial Support Provide technical specifications and requirements for procurement activities. Evaluate technical aspects of supplier and contractor quotations. Ensure procured equipment, materials, systems, and services meet required specifications. Support Procurement and Commercial teams in evaluating technical/commercial trade-offs. Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality, safety, or performance. Review proposed substitutions and alternatives from a technical perspective. I. Health, Safety & Risk Management Ensure technical activities are executed in accordance with applicable health, safety, and environmental requirements. Identify technical risks and contribute to project risk assessments and mitigation plans. Ensure appropriate technical controls are implemented for high-risk activities. Promote safe engineering and operational practices across technical teams. Participate in incident investigations where technical factors are involved. J. Client & Stakeholder Management Serve as a key technical point of contact for clients and external stakeholders. Attend client meetings and provide technical explanations and recommendations. Understand client expectations and translate them into actionable technical requirements. Manage technical queries, clarifications, approvals, and change requests. Build confidence and credibility with clients through strong technical knowledge and professional communication. Support business development teams during technical presentations and client engagements. K. Technical Reporting & Documentation Prepare and review technical reports, project updates, assessments, and recommendations. Maintain accurate technical records and project documentation. Provide management with regular updates on technical performance, risks, challenges, and progress. Develop technical dashboards and performance indicators where applicable. Ensure appropriate documentation of technical decisions, changes, approvals, and lessons learned. L. Continuous Improvement & Innovation Identify opportunities to improve technical processes, systems, productivity, and project delivery. Introduce appropriate technologies, tools, and methodologies that improve efficiency and reliability. Conduct post-project reviews and implement lessons learned. Promote standardization and automation where beneficial. Support the development of technical procedures, templates, checklists, and knowledge resources. Qualifications & Experience Education Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Construction, or another relevant technical discipline, depending on Noble Eagle’s area of operation. Relevant professional certification or registration is strongly preferred. A Master’s degree or MBA is an advantage for senior technical leadership. Experience Minimum of 8years of relevant technical/engineering experience, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or supervisory role. Demonstrable experience leading technical teams and delivering complex projects. Experience working across multiple stakeholders, contractors, vendors, and clients. Strong experience with technical documentation, quality control, risk management, and project execution. Relevant industry experience aligned with Noble Eagle’s technical operations is essential. Experience managing multidisciplinary technical teams is an advantage.
